screen.dioriteisntuseless.warning.title: ⚠ WARNING
screen.dioriteisntuseless.warning.body:
This mod contains psychological horror elements.

Nothing in this mod will harm your computer, your files or your worlds.
There are no jumpscares and no flashing lights.

But some things may not be what they seem.

Diorite isn't useless... right?
screen.dioriteisntuseless.credits.5: Code written with AI assistance (Claude), directed by Daio
config.dioriteisntuseless.title: Diorite Isn't Useless
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.server: You are connected to a server, so diorite is using the server's values. Changes here apply to your own worlds.
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.enable: Diorite uses the hardness and blast resistance below. When off, it is vanilla diorite (1.5 / 6).
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.hardne: How long diorite takes to mine. Vanilla: 1.5. Range: 1.5 to 50.
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.blastR: How well diorite resists explosions. Vanilla: 6, obsidian: 1200. Range: 6 to 1200.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.en: Breaking a log with the Dioritine Axe fells the whole tree. When off, it works like a normal axe: one log at a time and 1 durability per log.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.ma: Most logs a single swing can fell, counting the one you hit.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.lo: Logs it takes to use 1 durability. 2 means half a point per log.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.dr: Drops at the log you hit
On: everything drops together at the log you hit. Off: each log drops where it was.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.sn: Whether sneaking stops or starts tree felling.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.tr: The axe breaks after felling this many whole trees, no matter its durability. Repairing it on an anvil with Dioritine Ingots resets the count; Mending does not. 0: no limit. Range: 0 to 1000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.axe.durability: Maximum durability of the Dioritine Axe and the Dioritine Pickaxe. Requires restarting the game. Tools you already have keep their wear. Range: 1 to 10000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.axe.restrictEn: On: the axe and the pickaxe only accept Efficiency and Mending. Off: they accept the same enchantments as a vanilla axe or pickaxe.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.enable: Breaking stone or an ore with the Dioritine Pickaxe also breaks the stone and ores around it, in a 3x3 square facing you. When off, it works like a normal pickaxe: one block at a time.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.dropsA: Drops at the block you hit
On: everything drops together at the block you hit. Off: each block drops where it was.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.sneakM: Whether sneaking stops or starts 3x3 mining.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.strike: The pickaxe breaks after this many 3x3 strikes, no matter its durability. Repairing it on an anvil with Dioritine Ingots resets the count; Mending does not. Range: 1 to 1000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.minBlo: Fewest blocks a 3x3 swing has to break, counting the one you hit, to count as a strike. Swings that break fewer, at edges and corners, still use durability.
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.enab: The mod reacts when diorite is abused. Disable it if you only want the tools and blocks.
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.tree: Whole trees felled with the Dioritine Axe, after reaching the previous stage, to reach this one. Trees and pickaxe strikes add up: half the trees and half the strikes are enough. Range: 1 to 1000.
Whole trees felled with the Dioritine Axe, after reaching stage 4, to reach the final stage. Trees and pickaxe strikes add up. Range: 1 to 1000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.pick: 3x3 strikes with the Dioritine Pickaxe, after reaching the previous stage, to reach this one. Trees and strikes add up: half the trees and half the strikes are enough. Range: 1 to 1000.
advancements.dioriteisntuseless.wear_out: Wear out a Dioritine Axe. Congratulations on putting diorite to good use!
